import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from kh import *
meta=json.load(open('pass_15/meta.json')); print(meta.keys() if isinstance(meta,dict) else type(meta))
texts=meta['texts'] if isinstance(meta,dict) else meta
d=json.load(open('my_sents5_all.json')); lab={t:l for t,l in zip(d['texts'],d['labels'])}
miss=[t for t in texts if t not in lab]; print('missing', len(miss), miss[:3])
y5=np.array([lab[t] for t in texts])
cls=np.load('pass_15/cls_hidden_L11.npy').astype(np.float64); mn=np.load('pass_15/mean_hidden_L11.npy').astype(np.float64)
k=np.load('kernel_v3.npz'); mu,sd=k['mu'],k['sd']
x=cls+2*mn; xm=x-x.mean(1,keepdims=True); n=xm/np.sqrt((xm**2).mean(1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
Z5=(n-mu)/sd
np.savez('my5_feats.npz',Z=Z5,y=y5,texts=np.array(texts))
k4=np.load('kernel_v4.npz')
F5=gelu(Z5@k4['C'].T/768)@k4['A']+k4['b0']; p5=F5.argmax(1)
print('v4 acc on my5', (p5==y5).mean())
for i in np.where(p5!=y5)[0]: print(LABELS[y5[i]],'->',LABELS[p5[i]],'|',texts[i])
